title: Unknown stays unknown until ruled on
statement: Keep missing, ambiguous and conflicting answers, sources and rules open until one dated, named decision settles them, never inferring, averaging or widening them, and label anything built on them provisional.
example: In one corpus of rulings, 1,715 records could not show both a date and an authority or were marked pending, against 876 that could.
detail: The intake rules for a pedagogy decision bank say no answer may be inferred merely because a question is phrased yes or no: missing stays missing, ambiguous stays ambiguous, and conflicting sources stay in conflict until adjudicated. A corpus of rulings marked 876 records binding, with both a date and an authority extractable and no pending mark, and kept the other 1,715 as domain knowledge for lookup, but any evaluation probe built on them must be labelled provisional.
against: Some conflicts are settled by a standing order of authority instead, as in a ruling that per-lesson documents outrank the generic spec, itself a recorded decision (`grade3-reading/artifacts/DECISIONS-2026-08-24.md`).
